name: Schrodinger Mail Demo
description: Interactive post-quantum secure email demo using ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65, and AES-256-GCM.

QEC_DEMO_USERS.description: Seeded accounts shown on the demo login screen.

QEC_RESET_DEMO_ON_START.description: Reset shared demo data on every dyno start, avoiding a database add-on.

QEC_DB_PATH.description: Ephemeral SQLite database path for the public demo.

QEC_REQUIRE_AUTH.description: Require JWT/session authentication for protected APIs.

QEC_ALLOW_REGISTRATION.description: Prevent public key-generation abuse; use seeded demo accounts.

QEC_COOKIE_SECURE.description: Send session cookies only over Heroku HTTPS.

QEC_METRICS.description: Disable optional metrics work on the smallest dyno.
